items.title: School Pals
items.creator: Withercore
items.description:
Do you think school is boring? Not anymore when you have your best friends next to you! As the bell rings, y'all will heading way out of the class and collect great memories in your best outfit.

+ 10 stylish skins
+ Perfect for school roleplay
+ By Withercore

items.title: Cottage Core Mobs
items.creator: Asiago Bagels
items.description:
Today is the day you head back to the an old fashion era! But this time, you get to pick your favourite monster to go along with it! Buckle up your overalls, and get going.

+10 cottage core mob skins

items.title: Anime KPop Stars
items.creator: Asiago Bagels
items.description:
Do you ever dream about becoming a famous celebrity? You've been waiting a long time for this moment. Prepare to put on a show by dressing as your favorite celebrity in anime style!

+12 Anime KPop skins!

items.title: Viking Town
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Put on your viking helmet and take to the skies on your very own fire breathing dragon!

+ Fully furnished houses to explore or live in
+ Perfect for roleplay!
+ 4 cool skins
+ 1 FREE skin

items.title: Redstone Temple
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Explore an ancient temple, filled with loads of useful redstone items!

- Built using loads of redstone blocks to loot!
- Includes traps to avoid.

items.title: Secret Underground Mansion
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Tired of people finding your base? Well look no further! Explore the farms and enchanting room - or expand onto the base to make it your own.

+ Includes some valuable resources.
+ Rooms include a crop farm, mob farm and storage room.

items.title: Emerald Palace
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Start your world properly with this grand emerald palace!

- A huge castle, built with many emeralds!
- Spawn next to a shulker box filled with OP tools and weapons.

items.title: Luxury Anime Mansion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Experience the splendour of wealth in this anime inspired mansion! A vast house with gardens, tea room and parking space for all your cars is yours to have! Experience luxury the Japanese way!

- Anime style
- Mansion survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Roman Skyblock
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Live on this flying roman island and make it your own! On the roman island you will find:

- Brewing area
- Storage area
- Animals farms
- Enchanting Zone
- Parkour
- Loot chests
- Guide book
- And more!

- Roman island by Honeyfrost

items.title: Funky Jumpers
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
These jumpers are the talk of the town, so let everyone know you're in a festive mood! Show off your love of the holidays today!

- 13 Funky Jumpers!
- Perfect for the festive season!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Anime Party
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: It's your world time for an anime party will you be the superhero and defeat enemies? Maybe the villain who claims woodland mansions takes command of patrols, raids, and pillager outposts.

items.title: Glow Masters 2
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Glow Masters are back! Jump into action and light up the way with these masterfully luminescent skins. Your friends will be in awe over your radiating power!

items.title: Techno Avatars
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Defend space and the future with these armored heroes and heroines!

items.title: Creeper Crowns
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: These creepers have been crowned with greatness! Rule your world with these bright and colorful skins. Choose your favorite and stand out like royalty!

items.title: Halloween School
items.creator: Withercore
items.description:
There is nothing more exciting than going school in a Halloween night! Or should we mean scary? There is one way to find out; get off the bus and explore the neighbourhood. You can choose find clues in school or discover the outside.

+ Driveable vehicles
+ Perfect for Halloween roleplay
+ Spooky decorations & furnitures
+ Multiplayer friendly

By Withercore

items.title: Submarine Base
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: The submarine has surfaced and it is the perfect place to start your adventures. Reach the research facility, explore secret base and prepare for the dangerous mobs of minecraft.

items.title: Parkour Kraken
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Have a fun time jumping around on different levels made with different themes and beautiful sceneries. Run, jump and climb your way to the top!

+ 12 different levels!
+ Beautiful fantasy type scenery!
+ By Orbital Studios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Secret Lava Base
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Live in this secret well defended lava base and make it your own! In this base you will find:

- Lasers
- Cameras
- Automatic farms
- Mob arena
- Disco
- Elevator
- Storage rooms
- Enchanting room

and much more!

items.title: Medieval Mansion
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
Updated for 2023! Welcome to your own large medieval mansion! This survival spawn is the perfect base to start off your survival adventures.

+ Huge mansion with detailed interiors and plenty to explore
+ Large unique garden and forest
+ Custom medieval textures and six skins (original skins still included)

From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Masked Assasins
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Being an Assassin requires a lot of game intelligence. If you feel you are skilled enough to wear one of these outfits, get them immediately! Explore our different masks on each character. 

- 12 skins
- by RareLoot

items.title: Tokyo
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
A group of cool teens living in Tokyo. Become one of them and feel at home in your surrounding full of anime, sushi and other teen gamers.

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Axolotl Pvp Pros
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Being a dangerous and mighty axolotl is never easy! Get this pack and show them what you've got! Stylish and well designed just for you! 

- 12 skins
- by RareLoot

items.title: Surreal Skyblock Chapter 2
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The second chapter of "Surreal Skyblock" takes you to a fragmented world. Blocks of different kinds arranged in a mathematically correct way create this island in the void. Will you be able to defeat the dragon and advance to chapter 3?

-Surreal and cubistic world
-Confusing and challenging
-By Bumblesaurus

items.title: Adopt a Pet
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Adopt an egg from the pet store! Take care of it, by feeding it food. Watch it hatch into a random animal. Craft toys that make them do tricks. Stylish hats fit on every pet. They grant you abilities. Cats help you see in the dark. Rabbits help you jump high. Dragons let you walk in lava.
- 21 pets
- 6 special abilities
- 11 hats
- 4 villages
- 5 skins

Adopt them all!
